[L] states only `vanishing_box : massFilter P.patch (aliasAt 0 l)=0` for l != 0. The fact that area itself vanishes there (hv) appears only inside that proof, and no declaration states an order of vanishing or the vanishing of derivatives below order J. Getting order >= J from the J-th power needs an unwritten Leibniz or analyticity argument, so this claim has no counterpart beyond order one. No declaration states an order of vanishing; deriving it from the J-th power form and analyticity of area is an argument [L] does not write, so the item is weaker in that clause. evidence: [M] prints that the averaging symbol (b_l^j, which is massFilter P p = area P.L p ^ P.J with order_cut : 4 <= J) "vanishes to order at least j at every nonzero alias". [L] states only `vanishing_box : massFilter P.patch (aliasAt 0 l)=0` for l != 0. The fact that area itself vanishes there (hv) appears only inside that proof, and no declaration states an order of vanishing or the vanishing of derivatives below order J. Getting order >= J from the J-th power needs an unwritten Leibniz or analyticity argument, so this claim has no counterpart beyond order one. The finding stands as weaker, and it is not a typo: the proof (B-section.tex:343) argues the order deliberately.

[M] prints that the averaging symbol equals one at zero and 'vanishes to order at least j at every nonzero alias'. [L] has filter_zero (massFilter P.patch 0=1) and vanishing_box (l≠0 → massFilter P.patch (aliasAt 0 l)=0), with massFilter := area P.L p ^ P.J; the nearest quantitative statement, Flight.bills, bounds ‖massFilter (aliasAt p l)‖ ≤ C·decay j l = C·(mix l)^(-j) on a fixed cube, which is decay in the alias index l, not a factor |p|^j as p→0. No declaration states an order of vanishing; deriving it from the J-th power form and analyticity of area is an argument [L] does not write, so the item is weaker in that clause. Not a typo: the remaining clauses are as claimed.

provenance.method: mapper and verifier agents, a judge ruled; finding re-confirmed by two new skeptics after review; re-judged after an independent review; statements of [L] read at the pin, not built

evidence: [M] says the stationary Gaussian integral has field-dependent factor e^{−𝖳(v)} and that 𝖰(v) is positive near zero (B-section.tex:385-392). In [L], `treasury` (Joint/HaarJac.lean:63), `toll_pos` (Work/F05/Measure.lean:37), `carries` (Joint/Regulator.lean:527) and `commandment` (Joint/Completion.lean:384) give J_ax = |det Ds| > 0, X𝓡 = I and det(𝓡,𝓘)² = 1. But 𝖰 is positive definite only at v = 0 (`tested_diag`, Graphs.lean:29; `bend_det_pos`, Calculus.lean:79), near zero [L] has only det 𝖰(v) > 0 (`hessian_pos`, Graphs.lean:75), and `tribute` (HaarJac.lean:177) only unfolds 𝖳, so no declaration evaluates the integral to e^{−𝖳}.

`tested_diag` (Work/F05/Graphs.lean:29-35) gives positivity of the form at x = 0. `hessian_pos` (:75-79), via `bend_det_pos` (Calculus.lean:73-75), gives only det > 0 near 0, and PosDef appears only at 0 (Calculus.lean:79). `thermal_eq` (Push/LOOP_COEFFICIENT/Shell.lean:201-204) identifies T with loop + scalar but evaluates no stationary Gaussian integral to e^{−T(v)}.

T is only the definition `thermal`, no declaration evaluates a Gaussian integral to e^{-T(v)}, and Q(v) is positive only at v = 0 (`tested_diag`), with only det Q(v) > 0 near zero (`hessian_pos`).

citation.title: The construction of four-dimensional quantum Yang–Mills theory

provenance.method: mapper and verifier agents, agreed; finding confirmed by two skeptics; note revised after an independent review; statements of [L] read at the pin, not built

evidence: [M]'s first two lines (W_N = F_N^W(u_N), W_m = F_{N,m}(u_{m+1},W_{m+1})) match Cart.play (headA at the top, car downward via Nat.decreasingInduction). [M]'s third line is u_m=(2z_m)^{-1}[b_m^{-1}(e - sum_{i<m} D_{N,i}) - chi_m u_m^2], from the square-root coordinate beta_m = refbeta_m(chi_m x_m)^2 with the quadratic term retained, on formal series S(R). [L] has only `veil b z i = (pulse T i)^{-1} * (b - sum_{j<i} tally T N X z j)`, linear in the coordinate (also used this way in Crown/Fame.lean:47, Crown/Train.lean:40, Crown/Top.lean:16 locket), on complex points of Harbor N, with no (2z_m)^{-1} factor or quadratic term anywhere. The difference is deliberate in [M] (line 865: 'it retains its quadratic term'), so it is not a typo.

[M] prints three series equations on S(X) (formal power series in z): the Wilson top map, the downward activity recursion, and u_m=(2z_m)^{-1}[b_m^{-1}(e - sum D-hat) - chi_m u_m^2], which keeps the quadratic term from expanding beta_m=refbeta_m(chi_m x_m)^2 (eq:D-coupling-coordinate). [L]'s veil is `fun i=> (pulse T i:C)^{-1}*(b - sum_{j<i} V.tally ...)`, linear in the complex coupling b with no 1/(2z_m) factor and no quadratic term, on complex-valued PlotN, and play matches only the first two lines. No other declaration states the square-root coordinate or the series equations (grep of veil uses shows only unrelated RG12 declarations). The quadratic term is deliberate in [M] ('it retains its quadratic term'), so this is a genuine difference, not a typo.

provenance.method: two skeptics, each reading the LaTeX of [M] and the source of [L], failed to refute it

verdicts.summary: [L] states a different form; neither implies the other. [M] prints `u_m&=(2z_m)^{-1}\left[b_m^{-1} \left(\mathfrak e-\sum_{i<m}\widehat{\mathcal D}_{N,i}(u_{i+1},W_{i+1})\right)-\chi_m u_m^2\right]`.

annotation.note: Finding: `Camp.Cart.play` gives [M]'s first two lines (top map `headA`, downward recursion `car`). [L]'s coupling coordinate is affine, β = slope + pulse·x with pulse = β̂^{98/100} (`Camp.speaks`), so `Camp.Cart.veil` is z_i = pulse_i⁻¹(b − ∑_{j<i} tally_j) on complex points, without [M]'s factor (2z_m)^{-1}, term χ_m u_m² or square-root coordinate β_m = β̂_m(χ_m x_m)².

evidence: [M] assumes the stencil bound for every R > 1 (D-section.tex:759). In [L], `Scout` needs 1 ≤ R (Ray/Gain.lean:24), and `Rebar.recovery` (Ray/Anchor.lean:23) needs 1 ≤ a < p and gives (1−a/p)⁻¹C. So 2C at a = R/2 needs R ≥ 2, and only then does `fee (R/2) r` = 4e/(rR) (Amp/Head.lean:13, `course` :78) give 2C(4e/(rR))^k. `gardenL` is a polarization (Head.lean:15,77), but no Amp lemma states that it is symmetric.

`Rebar.recovery` (FullVolume/Ray/Anchor.lean:23) needs 1 ≤ a < p and gives `Scout a` with constant (1−a/p)⁻¹c. Only a = R/2 gives 2C and fee = 4e/(rR), and that requires R ≥ 2. For 1 < R < 2 the admissible a ≥ 1 gives a worse constant. `gardenL` (Amp/Head.lean:77) is built by mkContinuous with no symmetry lemma, so the claim stands.

    Prereset B q l N m p Q τ (fun x => X.read (v x)) := by

structure Prereset (B : Directed G I Z K P) (q : ResetPrices) (s : Set ℝ) (N m p : ℕ) (Q : In B.a m p)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (S : ℝ → Activities G (B.a.S.side m p)) : Prop where
  early x : x ∈ s → (S x).EBound (B.a.budget m) (funds B.a m q / 4)
  emit x : x∈s → ∀ V, flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅ →
    let R := B.kin.path N m; let A := (B.a.params m).clip
    target Q x V = Real.exp (u x * sites (B.a.S.side m p) - ((Q x).beta * mainTerm A R V + B.kin.alpha N m * secondTerm A R V + loop R V) -
      (S x).additive (B.a.budget m) V)

lemma Prereset.value_income (h : Prereset B q s N m p Q u S) (hV : flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x∈s) :
    (0 < target Q x 1 ∧ 0 < target Q x V) ∧ |scalar (target Q) x - u x| ≤ funds B.a m q / 4 ∧
      |vacuumError B N Q V x| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * (funds B.a m q / 2) := by

annotation.note: Both recursions are fields of Based (encode, unnormalized), with the beta-transport push as the block map and a_N^d cancelling between density and initial. [L] states them only for r(d)<=m<=N, while [M] prescribes them for all m<=N.

snippet.text:
structure Based (A : Hol G) (C : SectionData F) (r : ℕ) : Prop where
  ref : r ≤ N
  format : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N → ∀ v, (T.entries m v).Format 0 A (H.rep N p m)
  cap : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).remBound 0 (H.rep N p m) (Real.sqrt (H.levels.clock.forcedAllowance m))
      ((H.levels.params m).columns * F.coeffSize (F.core (T.entries m v).x))
  back : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x
  front : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * ((H.S.block m).val : ℝ)^d *
      F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x
  linear : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N →
    IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).x) ∧ IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).regular) ∧
    IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).forced) ∧ ∀ v, (T.entries m v).support = (T.entries m 0).support
  bare_coord v : (T.entries N v).x = v
  bare_germ v : (T.entries N v).regular = 0
  encode v U : (T.entries N v).density 0 C (H.rep N p N) U =
    ((H.S.a N : ℂ)^d) * ((H.rep N p N).eval U : ℂ) * initial C H N p v 0 U
  unnormalized m : r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).density 0 C (H.rep N p m) =
      ((H.S.block m).val : ℂ)^d • (H.levels.clock.op m p).push (H.β N p (m+1))
        ((T.entries (m+1) v).density 0 C (H.rep N p (m+1)))
  reads v : (T.entries r v).x = T.terminal v
  unit_coord m : r ≤ m → m ≤ N → (T.entries m (unitVec F H N)).x = unitVec F H m
  realForm v : T.terminal (star v) = star (T.terminal v)
  orients (k : Signed) v : T.terminal (F.act k.ortho v) = F.act k.ortho (T.terminal v)

structure Large (p : Sheet G) (j : ℕ) (L : Side) : Prop where
  odd : Odd L.val
  size : 3 ≤ L.val
  need : p.floorL j ≤ L.val
  kick (hj : p.first ≤ j) : (p.profile j).drift / Real.log L.val ≤ G.slopeConstant/4
  slow (hj : p.first ≤ j) : (p.profile j).drift / Real.log L.val ≤ ((j:ℝ)^2)⁻¹
  fits (hj : p.first ≤ j) :
    let X := p.profile j
    Real.log (1 + X.paths + X.width⁻¹ + X.columns + X.clip.relaxation + X.supportExponent) /
      Real.log L.val ≤ ((j:ℝ)^2)⁻¹

structure Paid {p : Sheet G} {w : Rolls p} {T : Protection w} {W : Delays T} {Y : Bar W}
    (B : Wait Y) (a : Levels G) : Prop where
  kernel : a.clock.kernel = p.kernel
  bar : a.clock.bar=Y.value
  stage : a.clock.stage=p.profile
  firstZero : a.clock.J 0=p.first
  firstOne : a.clock.J 1=p.first
  lengths : a.clock.factor=w.L
  theta : a.clock.theta=T.theta
  pays m : W.betaEntry (a.clock.J (m+1)) ≤ a.clock.hatBeta m
  paysHigher m : p.first < a.clock.J (m+1) → W.scaleEntry (a.clock.J (m+1)) Y.value ≤ a.S.scale m
  periods i : B.minLength ≤ (a.S.period i).val
  volume m i :
    let j := a.clock.J (m+1)
    W.shells j * (1+a.clock.coverSize m+a.clock.coverSize (m+1))^(W.growth j) ≤ (a.S.side m i).val
  run (j : ℕ) : p.first ≤ j → ∃ k : ℕ,
    B.readyHere j ≤ a.S.scale k ∧ B.window j (a.S.scale k) ≤ k ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, k-B.window j (a.S.scale k) ≤ i → i ≤ k+B.window j (a.S.scale k) → a.clock.J i=j

def PositionsUV (C : Family G) (e : Extraction.Sequence) :=
  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),
   ∃ f : Points n → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧
     (∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t → Tendsto (fun j => Order.smears C (e j) p v t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo f))) ∧
     ∀ l : List (Reach n),
       let F N := squall (C.S.a N) l (lifted C N p v)

       ∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t →

def remBound (o : Site n) (R : Rep G n) (varkappa budget : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ b ∧ a+b ≤ budget ∧ 0 < varkappa ∧

def Colors (P : DiffPlan S) (H : S.RealSpin) (d) : Submodule ℝ (Vector d S) where
  carrier := {g | (∀ i,g i (S.unit d)=0 ∧ obey (g i) P) ∧
    (∀ i (k : Signed) v, S.mirror H (d+1) k (g i v)=∑ j : Axis,(↑(k.matrix j i):ℂ) • g j (S.mirror H d k v)) ∧
       (∀ i v, S.conj H (d+1) (g i v)=g i (S.conj H d v))}
  add_mem' := by
    intro x y ⟨A,T,J⟩ ⟨B,F,U⟩
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq,Pi.add_apply,_root_.add_apply]
    refine ⟨fun i => ⟨by rw [(A i).1,(B i).1]; simp, fun a h v => (LinearMap.range _).add_mem ((A i).2 a h v) ((B i).2 a h v)⟩,
      fun i k v => ?_,fun i v => by simp [J,U]⟩
    simp only [map_add,smul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib,T,F]
  zero_mem' := by constructor <;> simp [obey]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c x hx
    obtain ⟨H1,H2,H3⟩ := hx
    have he i v : (c • x : Vector d S) i v=(↑c : ℂ) • x i v := by
      change c • (x i v)=_
      exact RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K:=ℂ) c _
    change (∀ _,_) ∧ _
    refine ⟨fun i => ⟨by rw [he,(H1 i).1]; simp, fun a h v => by rw [he];exact (LinearMap.range _).smul_mem _ ((H1 i).2 a h v)⟩,
      fun i k v => ?_,fun i v => ?_⟩
    · simp_rw [he,map_smul,H2 i k v, Finset.smul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _; rw [smul_comm]
    rw [he,map_smulₛₗ,H3,conj_ofReal,he]

  smul_mem' c p H n v x hv hx := by
    rw [show Fin.cons (c • p) v=update (Fin.cons (α:=fun _ : Fin (n+1) => WickPol G) p v) 0 (c • p) from

structure PhysicalWave {m : ℕ} (x : Ambient m) : Prop where
    projects (n : ℕ) (s : Tags m n) (i : Fin n) : ∀ᵐ k∂photons n, x (insertP ⟨n,s⟩ k) =
      ∑ j : SpaceAxis, polarization (k i) (s i).2 j * x (insertP ⟨n,update s i ((s i).1,j)⟩ k)
    symmetric (n : ℕ) (s : Tags m n) (r : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : ∀ᵐ k∂photons n,
      x (insertP ⟨n,s ∘ r⟩ (k ∘ r)) = x (insertP ⟨n,s⟩ k)

The public structure WilsonRegularity.running records only that some positive slope exists; the value 2 b0 is fixed in the proof of regular.

snippet.text:
lemma zeroUp_bound (C : Family G) (hc : C.Makes) {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) : ∀ᶠ m in atTop,
    ∀ N p : ℕ, m≤N → |C.path.β N p m / C.S.scale m - 2*b0 G| < ε := by

structure WilsonRegularity {g : GaugeGroup} (C : WilsonFamily g) : Prop where
  running : ∃ slope : ℝ, 0 < slope ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ p, |C.beta N p / Real.log (C.mesh N)⁻¹ - slope| < ε
  continuous (N p v x) : Continuous (C.insertion N p v x)
  invariant (N p v x) (t : Site (C.period p * C.denominator N) → g.image) (U) :
    C.insertion N p v x (fun e => t e.1 * U e * (t (e.1 + Pi.single e.2 1))⁻¹) =
      C.insertion N p v x U
  localSupport (v : C.Token) : ∃ stencil : Finset (Axis → ℤ), ∀ N p (x : Site (C.period p * C.denominator N)),
    let sites := stencil.image fun z => (fun i => (z i : ZMod (C.period p * C.denominator N).val)) + x
    ∀ U V, (∀ e, e.1 ∈ sites → e.1 + Pi.single e.2 1 ∈ sites → U e = V e) →
      C.insertion N p v x U = C.insertion N p v x V
theorem regular (C : Family g.core) (hg : g.IsSimple) (h : C.Makes) : WilsonRegularity (wilsonFamily C) := by

structure Makes : Prop where
  wilson : C.path.Selected
  sections (d : ℕ) : (C.localSection d).Sound C.params
  stages (d : ℕ) :
    d+3 ≤ C.path.levels.clock.J (C.ref d) ∧
    ∀ m, C.ref d ≤ m → d+1 ≤ (C.path.levels.params m).order ∧ d ≤ (C.path.levels.params m).power
  places (d N p : ℕ) : C.ref d ≤ N → ∀ x ∈ (C.localSection d).stencil,
    ∀ i : Axis, 20*((x i).natAbs + 1) ≤ (C.side N p).val
  /-- Section actually gives canonical mask test-size (cf eq:psect).
  Charge this constant before L. -/
  priced (d N p : ℕ) : C.ref d ≤ N →
    let P := C.path.levels.budget N
    let F := C.labels.level d
    let D := C.localSection d
    ∀ o : Site (C.side N p), ∀ i : F.Index,
      P.Regular (D.footprint o) (D.places (Pi.single i 1) o) ∧
      P.supBounds o (D.footprint o) (D.places (Pi.single i 1) o) ((C.path.levels.params N).columns *
        P.threshold^(F.grades i).2)
  calibrated (d N p : ℕ) : C.ref d ≤ N → (C.factory d N p).Based C.params (C.localSection d) (C.ref d)

annotation.note: Label G d with a Frame is V_d with the same radial condition, weights, bidegrees, invariance, bihomogeneous basis and conjugation. The coefficient space Frame.Coeff carries the sup norm, and the l1 coeffSize is only an auxiliary size used in estimates, so the mapper's norm difference does not hold.

snippet.text: abbrev Jet (G : Gauge) := (j : ℕ) → Taylor G j
abbrev Label (G : Gauge) (d : ℕ) := ↥(localFields G d)
abbrev Pol (G : Gauge) := MvPolynomial (Key G) ℂ
def bidegree (k : Key G) : ℕ × ℕ := (generation k, 1)

def invariantSpace (G : Gauge) : Submodule ℂ (Pol G) where
  carrier := {p | ∀ A : Jet G, ∀ u, read (colored u A) p = read A p}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  smul_mem' z p h A u := by rw [map_smul, h A u, map_smul]
  add_mem' {p q} hp hq A u := by rw [map_add, hp A u, hq A u, map_add]

def limited (G : Gauge) (d : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ (Pol G) :=
  MvPolynomial.restrictSupport ℂ {b | height b ≤ d}

def radial (G : Gauge) (j : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (Raw G j) where
  carrier := {A | (∀ i : Axis, Tensor.Sym (A i)) ∧ ∀ z : E4, ∑ i : Axis, z i • Tensor.diagonal (A i) z = 0}
  zero_mem' := by simp [Tensor.Sym,Tensor.diagonal]
  add_mem' := by
    rintro x y ⟨H,H'⟩ ⟨K,K'⟩
    refine ⟨fun i s r ↦ ?_,fun z ↦ ?_⟩
    · simp [H i s r, K i s r]
    simp only [Tensor.diagonal] at H' K' ⊢
    simp [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, H', K']
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c y ⟨H,H'⟩
    refine ⟨fun i s r ↦ ?_,fun z ↦ ?_⟩
    · simp [H i s r]
    simp only [Tensor.diagonal] at H' ⊢
    simp_rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_apply, smul_comm _ c, ← Finset.smul_sum,
      H', smul_zero]

structure Based (A : Hol G) (C : SectionData F) (r : ℕ) : Prop where
  ref : r ≤ N
  format : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N → ∀ v, (T.entries m v).Format 0 A (H.rep N p m)
  cap : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).remBound 0 (H.rep N p m) (Real.sqrt (H.levels.clock.forcedAllowance m))
      ((H.levels.params m).columns * F.coeffSize (F.core (T.entries m v).x))
  back : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x
  front : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * ((H.S.block m).val : ℝ)^d *
      F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x
  linear : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N →
    IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).x) ∧ IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).regular) ∧
    IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).forced) ∧ ∀ v, (T.entries m v).support = (T.entries m 0).support
  bare_coord v : (T.entries N v).x = v
  bare_germ v : (T.entries N v).regular = 0
  encode v U : (T.entries N v).density 0 C (H.rep N p N) U =
    ((H.S.a N : ℂ)^d) * ((H.rep N p N).eval U : ℂ) * initial C H N p v 0 U
  unnormalized m : r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).density 0 C (H.rep N p m) =
      ((H.S.block m).val : ℂ)^d • (H.levels.clock.op m p).push (H.β N p (m+1))
        ((T.entries (m+1) v).density 0 C (H.rep N p (m+1)))
  reads v : (T.entries r v).x = T.terminal v
  unit_coord m : r ≤ m → m ≤ N → (T.entries m (unitVec F H N)).x = unitVec F H m
  realForm v : T.terminal (star v) = star (T.terminal v)
  orients (k : Signed) v : T.terminal (F.act k.ortho v) = F.act k.ortho (T.terminal v)

    simp
  add_mem' := by

    intro b z
    have he (a : Axis) : grad a (diagonal ((x+y) a b)) z =

      change fderiv ℝ (diagonal (x a b) + diagonal (y a b)) z _ = _

  smul_mem' := by

    refine ⟨Submodule.smul_mem _ t hx, ?_⟩
    intro b z
    have he (a : Axis) : grad a (diagonal ((t • x) a b)) z = t • grad a (diagonal (x a b)) z := by

  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),

structure EnergyMomentumMeasure (H : HilbertSpace) where
  projection : Set Spacetime → H.Operator
  empty : projection ∅ = 0
  univ : projection Set.univ = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ _
  intersection {left right : Set Spacetime} :
    MeasurableSet left → MeasurableSet right →
      (projection left).comp (projection right) = projection (left ∩ right)
  selfAdjoint {region : Set Spacetime} :
    MeasurableSet region →
      (projection region).adjoint = projection region
  countablyAdditive (regions : ℕ → Set Spacetime)
      (measurable : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (regions i))
      (disjoint : Pairwise (Disjoint on regions)) (state : H.carrier) :
    HasSum (fun i ↦ projection (regions i) state)
      (projection (⋃ i, regions i) state)
  diagonal : H.carrier → Measure Spacetime
  finite (state : H.carrier) : IsFiniteMeasure (diagonal state)
  diagonalIdentity {region : Set Spacetime} (measurable : MeasurableSet region)
      (state : H.carrier) :
    ↑((diagonal state).real region) =
      inner ℂ state (projection region state)

structure PoincareAction (H : HilbertSpace) (Labels : FieldLabels) where
  Symmetry : Type
  [one : One Symmetry]
  [mul : Mul Symmetry]
  [topology : TopologicalSpace Symmetry]
  onStates : Symmetry → H.Operator
  onLabels : Symmetry → Labels.carrier ≃ₗ[ℂ] Labels.carrier
  onTests : Symmetry → TestFunction → TestFunction
  pureTranslation : Spacetime → Symmetry
  identity : onStates 1 = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ _
  composition (g h : Symmetry) :
    onStates (g * h) = (onStates g).comp (onStates h)
  unitary (g : Symmetry) (state : H.carrier) :
    ‖onStates g state‖ = ‖state‖
  stronglyContinuous (state : H.carrier) :
    Continuous fun g ↦ onStates g state
  coordinates : Symmetry ≃ₜ PoincareCoordinates
  identityCoordinates : (coordinates 1).1.val = 1 ∧ (coordinates 1).2 = 0
  productCoordinates (g h : Symmetry) :
    (coordinates (g * h)).1.val = (coordinates g).1.val * (coordinates h).1.val ∧
    (coordinates (g * h)).2 = (coordinates g).1.val.val (coordinates h).2 + (coordinates g).2
  translationCoordinates (x : Spacetime) :
    (coordinates (pureTranslation x)).1.val = 1 ∧ (coordinates (pureTranslation x)).2 = x
  pullback (g : Symmetry) (f : TestFunction) (x : Spacetime) :
    onTests g f x = f (((coordinates g).1.val⁻¹).val (x - (coordinates g).2))
  translationZero : pureTranslation 0 = 1
  translationAdd (x y : Spacetime) :
    pureTranslation (x + y) = pureTranslation x * pureTranslation y

  Symmetry : Type
  [one : One Symmetry]
  [mul : Mul Symmetry]
  [topology : TopologicalSpace Symmetry]

  onTests : Symmetry → TestFunction → TestFunction
  pureTranslation : Spacetime → Symmetry
  identity : onStates 1 = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ _
  composition (g h : Symmetry) :

  unitary (g : Symmetry) (state : H.carrier) :
    ‖onStates g state‖ = ‖state‖
  stronglyContinuous (state : H.carrier) :
    Continuous fun g ↦ onStates g state
  coordinates : Symmetry ≃ₜ PoincareCoordinates
  identityCoordinates : (coordinates 1).1.val = 1 ∧ (coordinates 1).2 = 0
  productCoordinates (g h : Symmetry) :
    (coordinates (g * h)).1.val = (coordinates g).1.val * (coordinates h).1.val ∧
    (coordinates (g * h)).2 = (coordinates g).1.val.val (coordinates h).2 + (coordinates g).2
  translationCoordinates (x : Spacetime) :
    (coordinates (pureTranslation x)).1.val = 1 ∧ (coordinates (pureTranslation x)).2 = x

structure W2 (theory : WightmanTheory H Labels) : Prop where

      (label : Labels.carrier) :
    theory.poincare.onLabels (g * h) label =
      theory.poincare.onLabels g (theory.poincare.onLabels h label)
  domainInvariant (g : theory.poincare.Symmetry) :
    Set.MapsTo (theory.poincare.onStates g)
      (theory.fields.domain : Set H.carrier) theory.fields.domain
  vacuumInvariant (g : theory.poincare.Symmetry) :
    theory.poincare.onStates g theory.fields.vacuum.1 =
      theory.fields.vacuum.1
  fieldCovariance (g : theory.poincare.Symmetry)
      (label : Labels.carrier) (test : TestFunction)
      (state : theory.fields.domain) :
    theory.poincare.onStates g (theory.fields.field label test state).1 =
      (theory.fields.field (theory.poincare.onLabels g label)
        (theory.poincare.onTests g test)
        ⟨theory.poincare.onStates g state.1,
          domainInvariant g state.2⟩).1

structure Reconstructed : Prop where
  axioms : T.theory.Axioms
  faithful : T.theory.fields.Faithful
  injective (d : ℕ) : Injective (T.toLabel d)
  acts : ∃ (a : T.Tag) (f : YangMills.TestFunction), T.theory.fields.field (T.toLabel a.1 a.2) f ≠ 0
  covers : Surjective (fun a : T.Tag => T.toLabel a.1 a.2)
  represents : Surjective T.project
  normalized : IsProbabilityMeasure T.phaseMeasure
  fullSupport : T.phaseMeasure.IsOpenPosMeasure
  permutation (s : Option T.Character) {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → T.Tag)
      (x : Points n) (hx : x ∈ WilsonFamily.separated n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    T.correlation s (a ∘ π) (WithLp.toLp 2 (x.ofLp ∘ π)) = T.correlation s a x
  smooth (s : Option T.Character) {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → T.Tag) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T.correlation s a) (WilsonFamily.separated n)
  characterContinuity {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → T.Tag) (x : Points n)
      (h : x ∈ WilsonFamily.separated n) : Continuous (fun i => T.correlation (some i) a x)
  mixture {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → T.Tag) (x : Points n) (h : x ∈ WilsonFamily.separated n) :
    (∫ i, T.correlation (some i) a x ∂T.phaseMeasure) = T.correlation none a x
  analytic {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → T.Tag) (space : OPESpacePoints n) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => T.continuation v z space) (orderedTube n)
  root {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → T.Tag) (x : Points n) (h : StrictMono fun i => time (x i)) :
    T.continuation v (imaginaryTimes x) (spatialPoints x) = T.correlation (some T.selected) v x
  boundary {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → T.Tag) (height : Fin n → ℝ) (h : StrictMono height)
      (tests : Fin n → YangMills.TestFunction) :
    Tendsto (fun r => ∫ x : Points n, T.continuation v (complexShift r height x) (spatialPoints x) *
      tensorTest tests x) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (T.theory.fields.vacuumExpectation (fun i => T.toLabel (v i).1 (v i).2) tests))

def IsSimple (gauge : GaugeGroup) : Prop :=
  (∃ X ∈ gauge.lieAlgebra, ∃ Y ∈ gauge.lieAlgebra,
    X * Y - Y * X ≠ 0) ∧
  ∀ ideal : Submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin (gauge.n + 1)) (Fin (gauge.n + 1)) ℂ),
    ideal ≤ gauge.lieAlgebra →
    (∀ X ∈ gauge.lieAlgebra, ∀ Y ∈ ideal, X * Y - Y * X ∈ ideal) →
    ideal = ⊥ ∨ ideal = gauge.lieAlgebra

def PositionsUV (C : Family G) (e : Extraction.Sequence) :=
  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),
   ∃ f : Points n → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧
     (∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t → Tendsto (fun j => Order.smears C (e j) p v t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo f))) ∧
     ∀ l : List (Reach n),
       let F N := squall (C.S.a N) l (lifted C N p v)
       let g := derive f (l.map Reach.where_)
       Cluster C e p n F g ∧
       Meets (NoHit C.S p n) (fun j => interpolated C.S (e j) (F (e j))) g ∧
       ∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t →
         Integrable (fun x : Points n => t x * g x) ∧
         Tendsto (fun j => sumOn F C.S p (e j) t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo g))

structure TraceExclusions : Prop where
  centered (f : Test4) :
    inner ℂ F.action.operators.vacuum (excitation F.action.operators (pinned F) f) = 0
  identified (f : Test4) :
    F.action.operators.field (pinned F) f =
      F.action.operators.field (S.pin 4 (stressTrace F.sector.energy)) f -
        (euclideanVEV S (selected F) (stressTrace F.sector.energy) * ∫ x, f x) •
          LinearMap.id (R := ℂ)
  shortDistance :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s^8 * (Real.log s⁻¹)^2) : ℝ) • euclidean F s)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Trace.Verse.award G : ℂ))
  positive : 0 < Trace.Verse.award G
  wick (Color : Type u) (palette : Wick.Palette Color) (left right : Wick.PolyField Color) :
    ∃ x y : Probe E4, HasCompactSupport ⇑(waveTest (productTest x y)) ∧
      F.A.world.W 2 (pairV F.action.J (pinned F)) (productTest x y) ≠
        palette.wicks left right (waveTest (productTest x y))
  maxwell (n : ℕ) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient n)
      (physical : ∀ w, PhysicalWave (U w)) (unit : U F.action.operators.vacuum = vacuum n)
      (translations : ∀ w (b : E4), ∀ᵐ x ∂sumMeasure n,
        U (F.action.action.orbit.translation b w) x = Probe.plane (forward x) b * U w x) :
    ∃ (f : Test4) (h : TestList n), HasCompactSupport ⇑f ∧
      (∀ i, HasCompactSupport ⇑(h i)) ∧ (∀ i, Probe.bar (h i) = h i) ∧
      (∀ i, Fields.causal f (h i)) ∧ inner ℂ (coherent (-h)) (signal F U f) ≠
        inner ℂ (signal F U (Probe.bar f)) (coherent h)
  invariant (n : ℕ) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient n)
      (hU : Comparison F U) (I : Type v) [MeasurableSpace I]
      (μ : Measure I) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (P : I → Ambient n → Ambient n)
      (preserves : ∀ z x y, PhysicalWave x → PhysicalWave y →
        inner ℂ (P z x) (P z y) = inner ℂ x y) (fixes : ∀ z x, P z (U x) = U x)
      (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ (A B : Set E4), IsOpen A ∧ IsOpen B ∧ closure A ⊆ ball 0 r ∧
      (∀ x ∈ closure A, ∀ y ∈ closure B, x-y ∈ spacelike) ∧
      ∃ (f : Test4) (h : TestList n), tsupport f ⊆ A ∧ HasCompactSupport ⇑f ∧
        (∀ i, tsupport (h i) ⊆ B) ∧ (∀ i, HasCompactSupport ⇑(h i)) ∧
        (∀ i, Probe.bar (h i) = h i) ∧
        (∫ z, inner ℂ (P z (coherent (-h))) (signal F U f) ∂μ) ≠
          ∫ z, inner ℂ (signal F U (Probe.bar f)) (P z (coherent h)) ∂μ
